paragraphs: A baraita reciter of R' Ami. Mentioned in [Berakhot 14a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.14a.7), where he asked R' Ami a question.[^1]

notes.text: Ashyan, a reciter in Rabbi Ami’s school, asks whether someone fasting may taste food. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=651&lang=en) records the same exchange. Here tanna describes his role as a reciter.
